- O1: Singleton per-Work-Item in-flight claim, held through SaveChanges and released in finally. Cost: one small registry and claim plumbing. Risk: process-local only. Fit: one API process with HTTP and hosted worker. Selected.
- O2: Coalesce or serialize the whole ProcessAsync call. Cost: simpler keying but unrelated work items block or share a potentially stale summary. Rejected because the requirement is per Work Item and HTTP summaries could stop representing that invocation.
- O3: Database claim/outbox/idempotency schema. Cost: migration, persistence-contract and operational changes. Fit: multiple replicas or durable delivery guarantees. Rejected because it exceeds the current schema/deployment boundary and could change the required notification-before-save semantics.

## Selected Option and Reason

O1 was selected using F1-F4 and A1: it closes the observed same-process race for the same Work Item without serializing unrelated items. Claims remain held until the existing SaveChanges completes and are released on success, false notification, exception, or cancellation, so F2/F3 Retry and Lost ACK behavior remains. E1-E6 validate the chosen boundary. U1 remains an explicit deployment limitation.

## When Other Options Fit Better

O3 is preferable if U1 confirms multiple application processes or if durable cross-restart deduplication becomes required. O2 could fit a tiny batch where all concurrent callers are intentionally required to share one batch result, which is not the current HTTP behavior.

## Behavior That Must Not Change

- POST route, 200 response, ProcessOverdueResponse JSON shape and existing statistics outside an overlapping claim.
- Later sequential retries notify already-Overdue items again.
- Lost ACK remains at-least-once: an ambiguous notification exception releases the claim and a later run retries.
- Cancellation propagates to notification and SaveChanges; canceled/throwing notification does not persist status.
- Notification stays before status persistence; false notification still persists Overdue.

## Expected Diff Boundary

Production: in-memory claim registry, processor claim lifecycle, singleton registration. Tests: deterministic HTTP plus actual Background Worker overlap Oracle and Lost ACK retry Oracle. No route, DTO, schema, package, config, deployment, commit, push, or external data change.

Modified OverdueWorkItemProcessor.cs, Program.cs, ProcessOverdueBehaviorTests.cs; added WorkItemProcessingClaimRegistry.cs and this untracked report. Smoke created ignored runtime logs/databases. No functional deviation from the expected boundary. A public registry type was required by the existing public processor primary constructor and Microsoft DI construction; TryAcquire remains internal.

## Validation Plan

TDD red/green for the race, focused Lost ACK test, full locked restore/build/test, format verification, vulnerable package query, baseline smoke, diff check. Existing full suite serves as Oracles for HTTP contract, cancellation, retry, and persistence order.

## Stop or Escalation Conditions

## Human Decisions Required
